name: listrow-chips-keep-label
description: ListRow: a collection row at phone widths with a long label and two state chips (a host row: 'connecting' + 'Restart orphan-unverified') must leave the label a readable width - the chips wrap under it rather than squeezing it to a few characters - and nothing may spill out of the row. A short label keeps its chips beside it on the same line.

mutation.declaration: widgets/listrow/listrow.module.css: .heading { flex-wrap: wrap } and .label { flex: 1 1 12ch } (both deleted - the pre-fix rule, chips flex:none beside a min-width:0 label, fails at 320px with the label squeezed to 14.6px); .label { max-width: max-content } (deleted alone - fails the 390px short-label fixture, its chips wrapped off the label's line)
